rationale.intervention_reconstruction: The hypothesis proposes alloying with Al or Cr to form an oxide scale, whereas the paper studied Re addition to refine microstructure and improve irradiation resistance. These are fundamentally different kinds of interventions.
rationale.condition_agreement: The hypothesis specifies isothermal exposure at 1000 °C in air, while the paper performed room-temperature He-ion irradiation and room-temperature mechanical testing. These are completely different regimes.
rationale.mechanism_agreement: The hypothesis invokes selective oxidation forming a protective scale, whereas the paper's mechanism relies on grain refinement, lattice distortion, and amorphous grain-boundary regions acting as defect sinks to suppress He-bubble growth. These are different classes of mechanism.
rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts lower mass gain and slower degradation, which are oxidation-related properties, while the paper measured irradiation hardening, compressive strength, and He-bubble distribution. The predicted property and direction are unrelated.
